title: Correct link to react-instantsearch page
body:
**Summary**

Removed instantsearch.js subdirectory in link to react-instantsearch page. Previously it caused a 404 and now points to the correct page.

**Result**

The link now goes to the correct URL, as evidenced by the following screenshot:

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/1909592/24770311/594e979a-1abe-11e7-864c-a04676c86e56.png)
